```yaml
name: Secrets Diagnostics

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  diagnostics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN }}
      GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod

      - name: Check secret presence
        run: |
          echo "=== Secret Presence Check ==="
          if [ -z "$GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN is NOT set"
          else
            echo "GH_AW_AGENT_TOKEN is set"
          fi
          if [ -z "$GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN is NOT set"
          else
            echo "GH_AW_GITHUB_TOKEN is set"
          fi
          if [ -z "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is NOT set"
          else
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is set"
          fi

      - name: Run Go tests
        run: |
          echo "=== Running Go tests ==="
          go test ./...
```
